class: ADP document upload needs a dialog commit
symptom: Resume upload stopped after opening the chooser dialog; no attachment was committed.
site: Church Mutual ADP Senior Network Engineer application 548, supervised continuation 25–26 October 2026
root_cause: The generic path expects an existing file input or native chooser, while ADP creates a shadow input after Upload and requires Save.
why_tests_missed: Existing fixtures did not model a deferred shadow input and a separate Save.
fix: Use the portal upload hook, respect guarded click denial and retain attachment-receipt verification.
